description: The caller registry's two file forms under contract 01. Thread-caller registry (the runner's config/callers.json; live file untracked, seeded from the tracked example): operator-written only, no code writes it. Machinery callers (panel, standing, test, lease) are code constants and are never listed. Token-caller registry (inside the scheduler's live config connector block): hashes only — raw tokens are minted once, never stored.

active.description: Registered callers whose work is detached-only; the sync gate refuses their synchronous attaches outright.

items.description: A caller id; a claim may carry one lane suffix (base:lane) validated against its registered base.

oneOf.description: Token-caller entry (one value of the connector callers map, keyed by caller name).

title: Caller registry forms (contract 01)
